title: Expert-2 Rule Sets
description: Knowledge bases written for Jack Park’s Expert-2 shell, dated 1984.
versionOrder: Disk saves have no recorded order or dates beyond their source comments. Any ordering here is a presentation guess.

versions.label: Forth Wiz (blocks 50-85)

attribution.text: Written for Expert-2, Jack Park’s rule-based shell in MMSFORTH (Dr. Dobb’s Journal, April 1984). The source names no author for these rule sets. Preserved here for small-scale archival use.
